places.name: Woodlands Waterfront Park Dog Run
places.notes: Fenced off-leash run in Woodlands Waterfront Park, the closest NParks run to home. About 600 sqm of grass with views over the Straits of Johor. Free, open 24/7. Breezy in the evening. A water point is mentioned in some guides but is not confirmed on the NParks park page, so bring water. Pair with a leashed walk on the waterfront promenade and jetty. Do not feed the monkeys. A reviewer reported fence gaps large enough for a small dog and sharp wet grass. Inspect the fence before letting him off leash.

places.name: Bukit Canberra Dog Run
places.notes: Fenced rooftop run at Bukit Canberra, opened 20 Jul 2025. Managed by SportSG / ActiveSG, not NParks. Closest dedicated run to Woodlands after Waterfront. Limited shade; water point not verified. Check lift access rules before going with a puppy.

places.name: Yishun Park Dog Run
places.address: Yishun Park, near Yishun Central and Yishun Ave 11 (Hopea Entrance)
places.notes: Two small double-gated fenced enclosures. Suits a small puppy's first run. Bring water and poo bags; the nearest water point is a walk away. Triangular, smaller than most runs.

places.name: Rockridge Park Dog Run
places.notes: Fenced run opened 22 Nov 2025. Still in active use as of a 15 Sep 2026 community Reel. Owner reported wet soil and mud after rain. Avoid after heavy rain.

places.name: Lower Seletar Reservoir Park
places.notes: Leashed family outing near the reservoir. Featured in 2026 dog-friendly roundups. Possible monkeys. Thin on direct owner social proof. Heat. Not a fenced run.

places.name: Woodlands Town Park East
places.notes: Hyper-local leashed walk, not a destination. Shown with dogs Jul 2026. No fenced run. Public-place leash law applies.

places.name: Marsiling Park
places.notes: Leashed neighbourhood walk. Owner walk dated 20 Aug 2026. No fenced run.

places.name: Merle and Co
places.notes: Pet-friendly cafe named after the owner's dog. Owner visit Jan 2026; HungryGoWhere feature Jun 2026. Indoor versus outdoor seating for dogs is not stated; mall indoor rules may apply. Re-check on arrival.

places.name: The Urban Hideout
places.notes: Indoor pet-friendly cafe; a pet menu is mentioned. Owner visit 15 Sep 2026. Policies can change; re-check before visiting.

places.name: Sengkang Riverside Park Dog Run
places.notes: Fenced run listed on Google Places with recent reviews. No official NParks page text found, so treat as likely. Nearby wetlands mean mosquitoes are likely.

places.name: Rivervale Shores Dog Run
places.notes: Community fenced run opened 19 Jul 2025 by Sengkang Town Council. Not NParks. Designated operating hours apply; confirm current hours with Sengkang Town Council before visiting.

places.name: Punggol Waterway Park Dog Run
places.address: Punggol Waterway Park, near Nibong LRT
places.notes: NParks fenced run. Older listings report a water point inside; not confirmed current. No direct 2026 owner visit post isolated. Leashed waterway walks after.

places.name: Punggol Park Dog Run
places.address: Punggol Park, near 471B Upper Serangoon Crescent
places.notes: Fenced run. Dogs shown running there in Sep 2026. Facilities not verified.

places.name: Bishan-Ang Mo Kio Park Dog Run
places.notes: Fenced off-leash run in the middle of the park, free, open 24/7. Two pens (small/medium and large) with water points on site. Busy on weekend mornings; go early or late to dodge the heat. Improvement works had an expected completion of 6 Jan 2026; reopening was not explicitly confirmed in the Sep 2026 sweep. Check NParks before visiting.

places.name: West Coast Park Dog Run
places.notes: Big fenced run (~22,000 sqm, the largest NParks run), popular with big-dog owners. Shaded benches, water taps, and a dog-wash kiosk nearby. Free, open 24/7. Pair it with a leashed walk along the park promenade after. 2025 improvement works should have ended; confirm current status before a trip.

places.name: East Coast Park Dog Run (Parkland Green)
places.notes: Fenced run (~2,000 sqm) a short walk from the beach. Do the run first, then a leashed stroll on the sand. Opening hours unverified (sources conflict), free entry. A weekly Bark and Bond dog social runs Wednesday evenings.

places.name: Sentosa Palawan Dog Run
places.notes: Fenced run right by Palawan Beach, with water points and agility modules. Combine off-leash time with a leashed beach walk; weekday mornings are quietest. Opening hours approximate (roughly 9am to 9pm daily). No aggressive dogs, no food in the run, supervise at all times; children under 12 not advised. Special-breed requirements are referenced but not published. Pets are not allowed on the cable car, Sentosa Express, Sentosa buses, beach trams, or the Sentosa Boardwalk. Drive, walk the scenic paths, or use a pet-friendly private hire.

places.address: Clementi Woods Park, West Coast Road
places.name: Clementi Woods Dog Run
places.notes: Quieter, shaded run (~4,000 sqm) on sloped terrain, free, open 24/7. Water point and benches on site. A good low-key option if the big runs feel like too much for a first outing.

places.name: Sembawang Park Dog Run
places.notes: Fenced off-leash run near the end of Sembawang Road. Free, open 24/7. No water point or lighting on site, so bring your own water. Location approximate. Secondary sources report a slope, little shade and no water point. Steep staircase access is unfriendly to a small puppy. Bring water.

places.name: Tanjong Beach, Sentosa
places.notes: Dogs allowed, leashed at all times per the official Tanjong Beach Club venue policy (outdoor sections only; dogs must stay leashed and off the furniture). The sand is unfenced, so recall matters. No off-leash area on the beach itself. The beach club operator has changed; alfresco pet access appears to continue but reconfirm before a visit. Check water quality before any swimming. Pets are not allowed on the cable car, Sentosa Express, Sentosa buses, beach trams, or the Sentosa Boardwalk. Drive, walk the scenic paths, or use a pet-friendly private hire.

places.name: Palawan Beach, Sentosa
places.notes: Leashed beach walks next to the fenced dog run. Dogs on leash per the official Sentosa FAQ; off-leash only inside the dog run. Zone bans apply around ticketed event spaces. Pets are not allowed on the cable car, Sentosa Express, Sentosa buses, beach trams, or the Sentosa Boardwalk. Drive, walk the scenic paths, or use a pet-friendly private hire.

places.name: Changi Beach Park
places.notes: Long, quiet beach, open 24h, free. Good for a calm leashed walk away from the weekend crowds. No dog run in the park.

places.name: Singapore Botanic Gardens
places.notes: Dogs welcome on leash across most outdoor areas. Off-limits to dogs: National Orchid Garden, Rain Forest, Learning Forest boardwalk and elevated walkways, Healing Garden, Foliage Garden, Evolution Garden, Ethnobotany Garden, Jacob Ballas Children's Garden, Mingxin Foundation Rambler's Ridge, and COMO Adventure Grove at Gallop Extension. Specified breeds must be muzzled; clean up after your dog.

places.name: Sembawang Park
places.notes: Beach park with shaded paths. Leashed walks; a calm alternative to the east-coast crowds, and close to Woodlands. The park also has a fenced off-leash dog run, listed as its own entry.

places.name: Coney Island Park
places.notes: Rustic trails and beaches; leashed dogs allowed per NParks. Check on-site signage, keep to trails, and watch for stray dogs and wildlife. Bring water; facilities are minimal.

places.name: Creamier @ Northshore Plaza II
places.notes: Famous for dog-friendly icy treats; pup cups confirmed on the brand's own posts (Jan 2026). Outdoor seating for dogs is likely but not re-confirmed in 2026, so check on arrival. PawWhere reported its last day as 31 Aug 2026. Treat as reported closed until a walk-by confirms. Do not plan a trip here without checking.

places.name: Canopy @ HortPark
places.notes: Garden setting, dog-friendly alfresco only; indoor dining with dogs is not established. Walk the park trails before brunch. Water bowls are mentioned in older reviews but are not guaranteed. No 2025 or 2026 owner-visit proof was found in the Sep 2026 sweep. Re-check before going.

places.name: Surrey Hills Grocer
places.notes: Grocer-cafe with a dog-friendly outdoor area, mostly outdoor and sheltered seating. Staff offer water bowls, and animal-friendly ice cream is on the menu. A good pit stop on the way to the west-side parks.

places.name: Wheeler's Estate
places.notes: Big lawn, very dog-welcome; dogs allowed inside and outside (Jun 2026). Outdoor seating across the estate; a destination brunch with the dog. Water bowls not officially confirmed. No 2025 or 2026 owner-visit proof was found in the Sep 2026 sweep. Re-check before going.

places.name: One Holland Village
places.notes: Open courtyards and alfresco cafes. Pet lifts, pet drinking fountains and water coolers, and leash hooks around the mall. Dogs on leash; cats in carriers. Official pet-friendly store list updated 11 Jul 2026; some stores require a carrier or stroller.

places.name: The Star Vista
places.notes: Open-air mall with wide walkways. Dogs leashed in common areas; pet rules in dining areas vary by outlet, with some requiring pets in strollers or carriers.

places.name: Tanglin Mall
places.notes: Has a Pet Garden where dogs can play off-leash. Leashed elsewhere in the mall; near the Botanic Gardens for a combined outing. A Pet Lovers Centre outlet and pet-friendly alfresco dining on site.

places.name: NEX
places.notes: Rooftop K9 Park on the SkyGarden, Singapore's first dog park integrated in a mall, with agility equipment and zones for all sizes. Dogs limited to the K9 Park and SkyGarden zone via designated Lifts 1 and 2; not welcome in other areas of the mall.

places.name: Waterway Point
places.notes: Leashed pets welcome on designated pet paths leading to The Pet Safari store. Note: the waterfront promenade is public NParks space, not a mall pet zone.

places.name: VivoCity
places.notes: Rooftop Sky Park and harbourfront strolls; designated Pet Relief Area at Level 3 Sky Park (waste disposal, dogs leashed). Dogs leashed at all times outdoors; no off-leash provision anywhere. All pets indoors must be handcarried, in a carrier, or in a pet stroller (open-top prams require leash or restraint). Dedicated pet lift at Lobby H to The Pet Safari, Level 3.

places.name: Tiny Away Escape, Lazarus Island
places.notes: Five tiny houses on Lazarus Island / Pulau Seringat. Pet-friendly units (1900, 1960, 2000, 2017) take up to two pets. S$30 per pet per stay; pets off the sofa and bed; a pet bed and bowl are provided. Ferry from Marina South Pier or Sentosa Cove; dogs leashed onboard, no extra ferry fare on Marina South Ferries. Public-place leash law still applies on the island; this is not a fenced NParks run. No shops on the beach side; bring water and food. Wildlife (monkeys, snakes) is possible. Bookings accepted until 31 Jan 2027; the cabins wind down after that. Too much for a young puppy; after 16 Oct plus a SingVet nod at the earliest. Four of five cabins were pet-friendly per Jul 2026 owner posts. The island concession concludes 30 Mar 2027. The St John's / Lazarus day ferry is a separate outing from this cabin stay.

places.name: Jurong Lake Gardens Dog Run
places.address: Jurong Lake Gardens, Yuan Ching Road
places.notes: About 2,200 sqm fenced run with grassy mounds. Multiple 2026 owner visits, latest 20 Sep 2026. Water point nearby rather than inside per one 2026 guide. Hours not confirmed.

places.name: Pasir Ris Park Dog Run
places.address: Pasir Ris Park, 125 Pasir Ris Road, near Carpark E (Area 4)
places.notes: About 800 sqm fenced run with a water point inside per listings. NParks park page updated 27 Jan 2026. Reviewers warn of ants and muddy puddles after rain.

places.name: Tiong Bahru Park Dog Run
places.notes: NParks describes a shaded, spacious fenced run (page updated 27 Jan 2026). Older user reports mention mud, ants and occasional snakes (anecdotal). Hours not stated.

places.name: Katong Park Dog Run
places.notes: NParks enclosed dog run (page updated 27 Jan 2026). Hours not confirmed. Older sources mention agility obstacles and benches.

places.name: Ang Mo Kio Town Garden West Dog Run
places.notes: Fenced run, usually less crowded than Bishan. No water points or benches reported. The park is on a hillock with steep slopes; watch a small puppy.

places.name: Bedok Town Park Dog Run
places.address: Bedok Town Park, Bedok North Avenue 3
places.notes: NParks fenced run. NParks explicitly states there is no water point. Bring water.

places.name: Bukit Gombak Park Dog Run
places.address: Bukit Gombak Park, enter via Bukit Batok West Avenue 5
places.notes: About 480 sqm fenced run on sloped terrain. No water point per a 2026 guide. Bring water.

places.name: Tembusu at Ginger Garden
places.address: 1 Cluny Road, Ginger Garden, Singapore Botanic Gardens
places.notes: Dedicated pet section with a separate entrance, which solves the gardens' restricted-zone problem. Most interior garden zones remain dog-restricted. Owner visit Sep 2026.

places.name: Oasia Resort Sentosa
places.notes: Paw-fect Retreat: one dog up to 15 kg per room, second dog for a fee, includes in-room dining and pet bed. An ~8 kg Cavoodle fits the published cap. Owner proof through 19 Sep 2026. Confirm package terms at booking. Pets are not allowed on the cable car, Sentosa Express, Sentosa buses, beach trams, or the Sentosa Boardwalk. Drive, walk the scenic paths, or use a pet-friendly private hire.

places.name: Amara Sanctuary Resort Sentosa
places.notes: Dogs of all sizes allowed per Apr 2025 release, up to two per room. Owner stays May and Sep 2026. Free-roaming peacocks and birds on the grounds; supervise. Confirm current terms at booking. Pets are not allowed on the cable car, Sentosa Express, Sentosa buses, beach trams, or the Sentosa Boardwalk. Drive, walk the scenic paths, or use a pet-friendly private hire.

places.name: Holiday Inn Express Novena
places.notes: Dogs and cats up to 25 kg per 2026 listings. Owner visit 16 Sep 2026. One of the closer mainstream staycations to Woodlands. Official terms not verified in this sweep; confirm at booking.

places.name: St John's and Lazarus day ferry
places.address: Marina South Pier or HarbourFront, ferry to St John's and Lazarus
places.notes: Singapore Island Cruise's St John's page (updated Jun 2026) allows 1 to 2 pets, leashed and under control, no carrier required. A third-party listing contradicts the operator page; reconfirm with the selected operator at booking. Leash law applies on the islands. Heat, limited shade, bring all water and food. Sparse return schedules. Distinct from the Tiny Away cabin stay.

places.name: Royal Albatross dog cruise
places.notes: Official dog-cruise page (Sep 2026): S$30 for dogs under 10 kg, includes a dog meal and onboard grass toilet. An ~8 kg Cavoodle fits. Motion sickness and heat are real risks. Sailing dates sell out. Reconfirm sailing and price before booking.

sourceNote: Curated Sep 2026 from official pages plus Facebook/Instagram owner posts. Rules change; verify before visiting. Off-leash only inside fenced runs. Hawker centres remain off-limits to pets. Not for Paddington until 16 Oct 2026 plus a SingVet nod.
